propagatesOnward.description: RFC 0128. When `true`, the host's onward OpenWOP-envelope hops (A2A forwards, trigger/sync events to OpenWOP peers) re-emit the label. Distinct from the family record only for hosts that read labels but have no onward-hop surface at all; a host WITH onward hops that advertises this facet MUST also propagate.
